title: farwa ka laal ran me tukdou me batgaya hai
body:
farwa ka laal ran me tukdou me batgaya hai
fizza pukari zainab masnad bichaao aakar
bachoun ka sog bibi kuch to badhao aqir
dulha dulhan se milne qaime me aa raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
masnad pe shaahe dee'n jo tukde jama rahe hai
tukdo me batgaya jo lasha utha rahe hai
hai khoon bhara ye manzar kya saqt marhala hai
laasha ki ja hai dekho tukde badan ke bikhre
<<DIVIDER>>
kubra dulhan ko koi aakar zara sambhale
gulgoo'n badan hasan ka maqtal se aa raha hai
kya dard ka hai manzar dekhegi kaise kubra
pamaal ho ke aya ibne hassan ka laasha
<<DIVIDER>>
sheeri'n suqan ka chehra kya jagmaga raha hai
